statement: No folder holds more than ten direct source files except at its recorded debt, counted on the files git lists, and a directory that is not a git checkout is red.
source: coordinator 09-30 (PR #71 review: a skipped or deleted gate test must turn the gate red)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it

layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-WIDTH a folder of 11 untracked source files is red and names the folder
too wide without debt is red; the debt must match exactly; an unused debt is stale
a directory that is not a git checkout is red, not an empty pass
